verdict.rationale: Kick's docs say it connects to bank and credit-card accounts through Plaid (12,000+ institutions) and that transactions arrive via a bank feed that syncs automatically, so the core of the story is covered. The docs never state the sync cadence, so the 'every day' part of the story is implied, not documented. Missing for 10: documented daily or recurring sync schedule, independent or hands-on confirmation of automatic import reliability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Plaid: connects to 12,000+ banks and credit cards. The primary method for most accounts.
Kick connects to your financial institutions through Plaid
Every transaction in Kick comes from a bank feed or an import.
Once a rule is created, it runs automatically every time a matching transaction syncs.
